notes: Custom policies are forbid-only: the generated baseline grants, a custom policy can only narrow it.
Blocks within one step are AND-joined; values inside one multi-select are OR-joined; exceptions (unless) are OR-joined.
Anything the builder cannot express is written as hand-written Cedar and edited in the Cedar editor.
Every point decides for the request's user and session when the request has one; a background job without a user (e.g. Knowledge indexing) is evaluated as User "unknown".

enforcement_points.label: Seat check
enforcement_points.checked_when: Checked when a coding agent starts on the user's own seat
enforcement_points.where: When a Claude Code session starts with the user's own seat instead of governed routing.

enforcement_points.label: Model admission
enforcement_points.checked_when: Checked whenever a model is called (chat, model gateway, Knowledge)
enforcement_points.where: Every model dispatch: chat, the inbound model gateway and Knowledge.

enforcement_points.label: Remote models
enforcement_points.checked_when: Checked when Knowledge uses a remote embedding model or reranker
enforcement_points.where: Knowledge indexing and search with a remote embedding model or reranker.

enforcement_points.label: Tool admission (chat & MCP)
enforcement_points.checked_when: Checked when an agent uses a tool (chat & MCP)
enforcement_points.where: Chat and MCP tool listings (hidden) and every tool call (refused).

enforcement_points.label: Coding-agent tool check
enforcement_points.checked_when: Checked before a coding agent runs a command or reads or writes a file
enforcement_points.where: The PreToolUse check of governed coding-agent clients, per shell segment and per file path.

enforcement_points.label: Tool-result check
enforcement_points.checked_when: Checked when a tool result enters a model's context
enforcement_points.where: Connector and MCP tool results in chat and over MCP, and coding-agent tool results reported by the launcher (content: the result).

enforcement_points.label: Device dispatch
enforcement_points.checked_when: Checked when a chat request is sent to the user's own device
enforcement_points.where: Before a chat message starts a job on one of the sender's own octryx-claude devices.

principals.label: User
principals.description: A platform user. Parents: their platform roles and active identity groups.

principals.label: Agent session
principals.description: One running agent session of a user (child of its User). Conditions use its attributes.

attributes.name: profile
attributes.label: Session profile
attributes.description: governed = routed through the platform model gateway; seat = the user's own seat.

attributes.name: client
attributes.label: Client
attributes.description: The client that opened the session.

attributes.name: sensitive
attributes.label: Categories this conversation already contained
attributes.description: Content categories detected in earlier requests of the same conversation (gateway session + client conversation id). A new conversation (/clear, new chat) starts empty.

principals.label: Platform role
principals.description: A platform role. Used as 'member of role'.

principals.label: Identity group
principals.description: An active identity group. Used as 'member of group'.

resources.label: Workspace
resources.description: A Workspace. Always present as context.workspace; the resource of use_seat.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.label: Data classification
attributes.description: Absent when the classification is unresolved.

resources.label: Tool
resources.description: A chat or MCP tool by name; child of its connector when it is a connector tool.

resources.label: Model alias
resources.description: A model alias of the model gateway; a seat model is "seat:<model>".

attributes.name: approved_for
attributes.label: Approved for sensitive data
attributes.description: Content categories the alias is approved for (Model gateway aliases → Approved for sensitive data). Seat models are approved for nothing.

resources.label: Remote model
resources.description: A remote embedding space or reranker, identified by kind and data-policy class.

resources.label: Shell command (one segment)
resources.description: One simple-command segment of a shell call (pipes and && are split).

attributes.name: parseable
attributes.label: Parseable
attributes.description: false when the command could not be split safely.

attributes.name: arguments
attributes.label: Has argument
attributes.description: Every token after the program plus the name of each name=value token.

resources.label: File path
resources.description: A candidate file path of a read or write call (absolute and working-directory relative).

resources.label: Device
resources.description: A user's own octryx-claude device; its parent is the owner (only the owner may use it).

attributes.name: profiles
attributes.label: Profiles on the device
attributes.description: governed and, with a seat login on the device, seat.

actions.label: Change data through a connector
actions.baseline: Granted by platform:tool-permit; a read-only connector level in the classification matrix denies writes.

actions.label: Read through a connector
actions.baseline: Granted by platform:tool-permit; the classification matrix narrows per level and connector.

actions.label: Call a model
actions.baseline: Granted by the Workspace model policy and the level's alias list (seat route: by platform:seat-route-permit after the seat checks); an unverified admission is denied; platform:secrets-never-leave refuses credentials on the gateway routes.

actions.label: Receive a tool result
actions.baseline: Granted by platform:tool-result-permit; content policies narrow it (mask or block).

actions.label: Run a shell command
actions.baseline: Granted by platform:client-tool-permit; narrowed by the Workspace gateway tool rules.

actions.label: Read a file
actions.baseline: Granted by platform:client-tool-permit; narrowed by the Workspace path rules.

actions.label: Write or edit a file
actions.baseline: Granted by platform:client-tool-permit; narrowed by the Workspace path rules.

actions.label: Use remote embeddings
actions.verb: embedding Knowledge with a remote model
actions.baseline: Granted when the model's data-policy class is at least the Workspace classification.

actions.label: Use a remote reranker
actions.baseline: Granted when the model's data-policy class is at least the Workspace classification.

actions.label: Use a personal seat
actions.baseline: Granted by platform:seat-permit; narrowed by an unresolved classification, the seat mode and the matrix.

actions.label: Run a chat request on an own device
actions.verb: running chat requests on own devices
actions.baseline: Granted by platform:device-run-permit once the Workspace turned device runs on; narrowed by the allowed profiles, the device's folder allowlist and the matrix rule 'Device runs'.

context.name: connections
context.label: Named connections
context.description: Named-connection ids (or "default") the call runs on; empty for a listing.

context.name: point
context.label: Check layer
context.description: gateway = the server-side check; client = the client's own permission rules (generated only).

context.name: route
context.label: Route
context.description: seat = the user's subscription through the seat proxy; governed = the gateway aliases (inbound gateway or the platform's own dispatch).

context.name: content
context.label: What the scan found
context.description: scanned, complete, detected (detector ids), categories, findings (count), sources (system, prompt, tool_result, document, history). Never the data.

context.name: origin
context.label: Tool origin
context.description: connector/MCP tool in the platform, or a coding-agent tool reported by the launcher (resource Tool::"client:<name>").

condition_blocks.label: On named connection …
condition_blocks.note: Shown by name, stored by id. "default" is the unnamed default entry.

condition_blocks.label: Remote model's data-policy class is below …
Command starts with …
condition_blocks.note: A prefix cannot see a subcommand after options (kubectl --context x delete …); prefer program + arguments.

condition_blocks.label: Path matches …
condition_blocks.note: * matches any characters including "/". ? and [..] are not supported.

condition_blocks.label: Unless the command has option value …
Route is …
condition_blocks.note: seat = the user's subscription through the seat proxy; governed = the gateway aliases.

condition_blocks.label: … or the conversation already contained this category
condition_blocks.note: Only with a route outcome: keeps a routed conversation on the approved model until it is cleared.

condition_blocks.label: … or the scan could not finish
Except models approved for the categories

outcomes.label: Block
outcomes.description: Refuse the request. Nothing is sent; the user sees which policy and what was found.

outcomes.label: Mask
outcomes.description: Replace the findings with placeholders, then send the request on its route.

outcomes.label: Route to an approved model
outcomes.description: Send the request unchanged to a governed model approved for this data.

outcomes.label: Mask and route
outcomes.description: Mask the findings and send the request to the approved model.

templates.label: Production connection read-only
templates.description: No changes through the named production connection; reads stay allowed.

placeholders.label: Production connection
placeholders.hint: Pick the named connection(s) that reach production.

model.name: Production connection read-only
model.description: No agent may change data through the production connection; reads stay allowed.

templates.label: Confidential → approved model only
templates.description: Confidential and higher Workspaces may only call the approved model.

placeholders.label: Approved model
placeholders.hint: Pick the model alias(es) confidential Workspaces may still call.

model.name: Confidential → approved model only
model.description: Sensitive Workspaces stay on the approved model.

templates.label: Block destructive commands
templates.description: Coding agents may not delete cluster resources, force-push or wipe directories.

model.name: Block destructive commands
model.description: Destructive shell commands are never run by coding agents.

templates.label: Block secret files
templates.description: Coding agents may not read or write .env files, private keys or credential stores.

model.name: Block secret files
model.description: Secrets on disk stay out of the agent's context.

templates.label: kubectl restarts only in non-prod
templates.description: Members of a role may restart deployments only with the non-prod context.

placeholders.label: Role
placeholders.hint: Pick the role whose restarts are limited.

placeholders.label: Non-prod context
placeholders.hint: The option value of the allowed context, e.g. --context=<non-prod context>.

model.name: kubectl restarts only in non-prod
model.description: Deployment restarts are limited to the non-prod context.

templates.label: No remote embeddings for confidential
templates.description: Knowledge in confidential and higher Workspaces stays on local models.

model.name: No remote models for confidential
model.description: Knowledge in confidential and higher Workspaces stays on local models.

templates.label: No log reads in restricted Workspaces
templates.description: Tools that read logs are blocked from restricted upward.

model.name: No log reads in restricted Workspaces
model.description: Tools that read logs are blocked from restricted upward.

templates.section: Sensitive data in requests and tool results
templates.label: Secrets never leave
templates.description: A model request that contains a credential is refused on every route.

model.name: Secrets never leave
model.description: Credentials are never sent to a model.

templates.section: Sensitive data in requests and tool results
templates.label: PII masked for unapproved models
templates.description: Email addresses, phone numbers and IBANs are masked unless the model is approved for personal data.

model.name: PII masked for unapproved models
model.description: Personal data reaches only models approved for it unmasked.

templates.section: Sensitive data in requests and tool results
templates.label: Seat sessions read logs only via governed tools
templates.description: A coding agent on a personal seat may not run kubectl logs / exec, stern or aws logs (existing blocks, no content scan).

model.name: Seat sessions read logs only via governed tools
model.description: Raw log reads on a personal seat go through the governed log tools instead.

templates.section: Sensitive data in requests and tool results
templates.label: Workspace identifiers stay on the approved model
templates.description: Requests with a Workspace-defined identifier (custom detector) are served by the approved model only.

placeholders.label: Workspace detector
placeholders.hint: Pick the custom detector of your identifiers (Detectors tab).

placeholders.label: Approved model
placeholders.hint: Pick a model alias approved for the detector's category.

model.name: Workspace identifiers stay on the approved model
model.description: Workspace identifiers are served by the approved model only.

templates.section: Sensitive data in requests and tool results

templates.description: Requests with health data (Workspace detectors of category health) are refused on the seat route.

placeholders.hint: Pick the custom detectors of category health (there is no built-in health detector).
